chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Abu Hafs Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
He said: The debaters of this sect are more evil than them from every category.
ai.seo_question: Who are considered worse than the members of a sect according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) asserts that the debaters of a specific sect are worse than its members across all categories, highlighting the severity of intellectual arrogance and argumentation within religious groups. This hadith, found in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid*, underscores the Shia scholarly caution against *kalam* (speculative theology) that leads to division, distinguishing between sincere belief and the pride of dialectical dispute.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 31. And with the same chain of transmission, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ahmad on the authority of Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, on the authority of Abu Hafs `Umar ibn `Abd al-`Aziz, on the authority of a man, that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said:
“The debaters of this sect are the most evil of all the categories.”
